All.name: Careful Spell
All.effect: Increase the action cost of the spell by 1

All.name: Channeled Spell
All.effect: Reduce the mana cost of the spell by its rank times your WIL

All.name: Close-range Cast
All.effect:
You cast the spell in a way to weave in the flow of combat. 
Adjacent creatures have a -1 penalty to their saving throw of the spell instead of a +2 bonus

All.name: Distant Spell
All.effect:
Double the range of the spell.
If the spell had a range of touch, it's instead 3 tiles

All.name: Expand Spell
All.effect: Increase the amount of the tiles the spell effects by one row or column. (4x4 to 4x5 for example)

All.name: Fuel Spell
All.effect: Increase the amount of dice dealt by the spell. You take that dice's damage as Vital damage.

All.name: Obscure Spell
All.effect:
You weave the mana in an unorthodox fashion for the spell, giving any attempts to Identify it a -5 penalty.
Alternatively you may attempt to make the spell appear as another spell you know.

All.name: Sculpted Spell
All.effect:
Choose one creature in the area of the spell to not be affected by the spell.
 You may choose more than one creature, increasing the Spellshaping DC by one for each extra creature.

All.name: Tracing Spell
All.effect:
You attach a thread of mana to the target with the spell
If the target is in range of a mana thread attach one

All.name: Armor Breaking Spell
All.effect:
You infuse the spell with more force to overwhelm and shatter armor.
The instant damage done by the spell ignores resistance equal to its rank + your INT or WIL

All.name: Elemental Shift
All.effect: Shift the spell's damage type to an aspect you have [Basic Elemental Magic] with

All.name: Homing Spell
All.effect: Increase the initial Save of the spell by 3.

All.name: Quick Spell
All.effect: Reduce the action cost of the spell by 1 (minimum one action)

All.name: Sustaining Spell
All.effect: The first three turns the spell sustains itself, needing no action from you

All.name: Ride the lightning
All.effect: Move to any location the spell hits

All.name: Twin Spell
All.effect:
Casts the spell at two targets within range, use the same spellshaping for both. 
Gives the spell the Draining Trait (it costs twice the mana)

All.name: Compressed Spell
All.effect:
Instead of being cast immediately, the spell is prepared and stored in a dimensional bubble. 
It can be released later as reaction to any trigger
At the end of each turn you hold a Compressed Spell, you pay a third of its mana cost or its cast automatically, centered on you
